tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Neutral, about 46% of a page. Page background: warm ivory by day, deep earth by evening. The default ground for everything.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Neutral, counted with surface. The site header (white), cards, form fields, the booking panel.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Neutral, about 20% of a page. Linen: alternating page sections, the footer, quiet bands.

tokens.name: sand
tokens.usage: Neutral, about 12% of a page. Image placeholders, tinted panels, the affirmation tile's default ground. Body text only in ink on it; ink-muted is large text only (4.4:1 light).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card edges — decorative only, never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and outline-button borders: 3.4:1 on surface (light), 3.9:1 (dark).

tokens.name: photo-veil
tokens.usage: A wash laid over a photograph that carries text (affirmation tiles), so ink text stays legible in both themes: a faint ivory lift by day, a deep earth veil by evening.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Natural dark, about 4% of a page: the text itself. Headlines and body copy on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and sand (10:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy, captions, metadata on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken (5.1:1+ light, 6.8:1+ dark).

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Accent, about 3% of a page. The logo's gold. Marks, ornaments, hairline rings, icons and display type 24px+ only — 3.0:1 on surface (light), too low for body text.

tokens.name: gold-ink
tokens.usage: Accent, counted with gold. Gold you can read: eyebrows, links, the primary button fill. 5.4:1 on surface (light), 9.9:1 (dark).

tokens.name: on-gold-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a gold-ink fill (primary button). Never literal white.

tokens.name: forest
tokens.usage: Accent, at most 1.5% of a page: a button-sized moment, a small band or an icon, never a full-width section by default. Pair with on-forest text. Use it for one focused accent, such as a small booking card.

tokens.name: on-forest
tokens.usage: Text on forest (9.2:1 light, 10.9:1 dark). Gold on forest is display-size only.

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Natural mid-tone, about 5% of a page: a tile or an image, never a whole section. Ink text on it (6.6:1 light, 5.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: clay
tokens.usage: Accent, under 1%: a single detail. A terracotta detail in imagery or a mood strip. Never text on light (3.9:1 with ink).

tokens.name: chestnut
tokens.usage: Accent, under 1%: a single detail. Deep wood-brown detail; on-forest text on it (8.4:1).

tokens.name: stone
tokens.usage: Neutral, about 7% of a page. Stone/plaster field for mood strips and placeholders. Decorative only.

tokens.name: ocean
tokens.usage: Accent, under 1%: comes mostly from the sea imagery. Petrol blue for water and stillness; ivory text on it in light (6.3:1).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Form success message text on surface, always with the words 'Thank you' or a check icon.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Form error text and the invalid field border, always with a written message.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Cormorant Garamond echoes the high-contrast O of the logo. Light weights at large sizes; never bold.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero headline, one per page. Scales to 52px on phones.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Section titles on landing sections. 40px on phones.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Sub-section and card-group titles. 30px on phones.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card titles, FAQ questions, testimonial names in serif.

styles.name: affirmation
styles.usage: Affirmation tiles and pull quotes only — italic is reserved for the voice of reflection.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Jost, a geometric sans close to the logo's SALON lettering. Body never below 16px.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Transformation is possible when we reconnect with ourselves with honesty, compassion and courage.
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under a section title, max 60ch.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: I guide others not only through education and training, but through lived understanding.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Card metadata, form help text, footer links.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase label above a title, in gold-ink. Echoes the spaced SALON of the logo.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks: eyebrow to title.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Form label to field.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile page gutter; paragraph spacing.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones; grid gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; desktop page gutter.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between title block and content.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Hero padding; breathing room around affirmations.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Photography, bands, mood strips — most of the site is square-edged.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs and buttons: a softened corner, not a rounded one.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards and the booking panel.

tokens.name: radius-arch
tokens.usage: Top corners only, for arch-topped images (the arched-alcove motif). Also pills/tags.

shadow.note: Almost flat: depth comes from colour fields and hairlines, like embossed paper.

tokens.name: shadow-soft
tokens.usage: Cards on hover, the scrolled header, the booking panel.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Every focusable element on :focus-visible: a 2px gap in surface, then a solid 2px ink ring (13:1).

tokens.name: width-text
tokens.usage: Max width of running text and forms.

tokens.name: width-content
tokens.usage: Max width of section content.

tokens.name: width-wide
tokens.usage: Max width of full-bleed bands' inner content and the header.
